title: Meet the Voices Behind the Phone: Support Center Staff!
summary: Meet the Voices Behind the Phone, featuring the Support Center Staff! Technical questions? Our Support Center team is here to help!
body_markdown:
## Technical questions? Our Support Center team is here to help!


Donegal’s Support Center team assists’ agents and policyholders with navigating our website and resolving technical issues. We take time to understand the problem, explain the next steps and work with our internal teams to find a thorough solution.


Beyond resolving individual concerns, the Support Center team can identify recurring issues and improve the systems you rely on. Our goal is simple: make it easier to do business with Donegal, so you can get back to what matters most.


## Meet the team:


# **Chris**


#### Support Center Manager


###### **Time at Donegal: 12 Years**


**Meet Chris**


“Originally my family is from Michigan. I went to college at a school in Florida, and my wife, daughter and our dopey dog now live in Lancaster, local to Donegal’s Home Office. I previously spent a few years in various business analyst positions, where I worked on many of Donegal’s internal projects, including our policy management system migration over the past several years, WritePro 2.0’s redesign, and a lot more. Today, I work with my team to focus on enhancements that improve our end-user experience and workflow efficiencies.”


**Fun Fact**


“I’m a bigger book nerd than most people might guess! I love collecting audiobooks and often have one playing in the background while I work on other things. Between listening and reading, I can sometimes get through hundreds of books in a year. Brandon Sanderson is my current favorite author because of the scale of his storytelling across multiple series.”


# **Jessica**


#### Support Center Supervisor


###### **Time at Donegal: 10 Years**


**Meet Jessica**


“I entered the insurance industry 13 years ago as an agent, and then started at Donegal in the Resource Center in 2016 before joining the Support Center team in 2018. From there, I moved into the Support Team Lead role in 2024, and most recently transitioned into a new Support Center supervisor role! I enjoy having the opportunity to identify problems and improve the end user experience with our systems and our website.”


**Fun Fact**


“I am a huge animal lover. We have 4 dogs, 4 cats and 3 horses. We have also fostered a total of 30 dogs for Humble Hounds Animal Rescue over several years.”


# **Tesla**


#### Technical Support Specialist


###### **Time at Donegal: 4 Years**


**Meet Tesla**


“I happily live in rural Pennsylvania with my husband, two dogs, three cats and two tree frogs. I love to read, go antiquing, volunteer with Nirvana Animal Rescue, make memories with family and friends, try new craft hobbies and stop at every Cracker Barrel I am near. My family calls me the chaos coordinator, and I love finding solutions to problems, which makes my job with troubleshooting a breeze! I love working for Donegal and the agents we get to connect with daily.”


**Fun Fact**


“I am a big empath and have a huge heart for living creatures. My husband is not shocked by any of my Snow White moments or the random critters that I proudly and randomly bring to him.”


# **Heather**


#### Technical Support Specialist


###### **Time at Donegal: 4 1/2 Years**


**Meet Heather**


“I’m an adrenaline junkie and avid outdoors person. I ride and train horses, ride street bikes, fast four wheelers, kayak, hike, rock climb, you name it! I have two grown sons, three horses, three cats and two dogs, so I stay pretty busy. My favorite thing about working in support is the variety of things we do day to day. It’s never the same day twice! I also work with a wonderful team that makes even the busiest day a lot more fun.”


**Fun Fact**


“I collect animal skulls. I’m very proud that my collection has all been collected ethically, either by natural passing or road demise.”


# **Amanda**


#### Technical Support Specialist


###### **Time at Donegal: 3 Years**


**Meet Amanda**


“I enjoy helping others and often rely on my mantra of ’you have to be a villager if you want a village‘. That applies to all aspects of my life, including work and home. Whether helping agents navigate our system or supporting my team, I love to jump in and support wherever I can. At home, I love spending time with my family, going outdoors and jumping into any body of water that isn’t filled with gators. I’m also passionate about staying involved in my local community, and advocating for human rights!”


**Fun Fact**


“I collect a rock from every vacation or destination I visit. Recently I went to Minnesota to visit my sister and collected a piece of taconite from the Black Rock Beach on Lake Superior, and some an agate from Gooseberry Falls.”


# **Shayle**


#### Technical Support Specialist


###### **Time at Donegal: 8 Years**


**Meet Amanda**


“I have been a licensed insurance agent for 20 years and worked on the agency side before coming to Donegal 8 years ago. I have always loved helping people and am an extrovert through and through. Outside of work, I enjoy watching Eagles football, Phillies baseball, fishing, and relaxing by my pool in the hot summer sun. My family and friends are the most important things to me, and I spend as much time with them as I can. I am married with a son, 2 dogs, and 3 cats, and I reside close to my hometown of Lancaster, PA, home of the BEST Amish baked goods.”


**Fun Fact**


“After high school, I served in the United States Marine Corps in the Airwing. I was stationed in Okinawa, Japan; Willow Grove, PA; and New River, NC. I served overseas in Operation Enduring Freedom and Operation Iraqi Freedom. During my service, I was able to travel all over the world, including Japan, Australia, Turkey, Croatia, and Bahrain. I am still the only female in my family tree to serve in the military.”


# **Erika**


#### Technical Support Specialist


###### **Time at Donegal: 2 Years**


**Meet Erika**


“I have been a licensed insurance producer for almost 20 years and worked at agencies for most of that time. I draw on my years of experience to help troubleshoot issues or technical errors that agents and insureds may be having. I love problem solving, so being on the Support Team is right up my alley!”


**Fun Fact**


“At almost 40 years old, I took up a new hobby: BMX racing! My husband builds custom BMX style bicycle frames. I got bored watching everyone else have all the fun, so I decided to give it a try and I love it! The competition is great between the BMX moms!”


# **Gabrielle**


#### Technical Support Specialist


###### **Time at Donegal: 4 Years**


**Meet Gabrielle**


“I am a Pennsylvania native, but relocated to Florida with my husband late last year. We have 3 cats. I spend my free time pin-trading at Disney, cross-stitching, playing video games, and spending time with my family. I may live in Florida now, but GO BIRDS forever!!!”


**Fun Fact**


“I received a black belt in Taekwondo when I was a teenager. I am hoping to return to martial arts someday.”


### If you need assistance or have questions, our Support Center team is here to help!
Visit **DonegalGroup.com** or call **888-640-5840** to get in touch with our team.
